@about: Every text QiTV shows, in English. A new language: `uv run python scripts/i18n_extract.py --init <code> --name <its own name>`, then fill in each translation of i18n/<code>.json (an empty one shows English). Keep every {field}; a plural entry holds the forms the language needs (one, few, many, other). @context explains texts whose meaning is unclear; @plurals has each counted text's English plural.
